## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta13

### Legend visibility and managed schedule control
- Make the map legend follow the same visibility settings as the map: **Channel** disappears when Channels are hidden and **Gate area** disappears when Gate areas are hidden.
- Add **Custom area** to the map legend when Custom Areas are enabled and available for the mower.
- Add an **On/Off** switch directly to the Navimower Schedule dialog.
- The schedule switch controls the integration-owned `switch.navimower_schedule`, so with current Navimower releases Off pauses scheduler ownership/runtime and On resumes it; it does not send the mower Pause command.
- Keep scheduler execution, queue ownership and cycle semantics in the Navimower integration; the card only controls the Home Assistant switch entity.
- Add regression coverage for legend visibility, Custom Area legend discovery and the managed-schedule switch action.
